title: The Worker Configuration File
description: Three keys in wrangler.toml that give a Worker project its identity: its name, its entry point, and its runtime compatibility date.

steps.description: This is the project's configuration file, `wrangler.toml`. Three keys give the project its identity.
`main` names the entry point file that Cloudflare runs.
`compatibility_date` pins runtime behavior to a specific date, so future platform updates cannot silently change your deployed behavior.
